title: The Pages kit gets the app's own pieces

steps.path: A practice Page showing every kit piece (practice app only)
steps.headline: The kit's new pieces, all on one Page.
steps.changed: Status labels (with dots for live states), info/warning/error notice boxes with Details folding inside and buttons below it, the loading line, on/off switches, a search box with filter chips at the same height, an inner box, fold-out rows, the sideways chip row, the full-screen error, and the scroll fade on every scrolling area.
steps.notice: Each matches the app's own piece. The page-builder skill now tells the assistant to use these before hand-making anything — and that your own direction for a Page always wins.
steps.risk: In Halftone, info pieces come out pink, as they do in the app itself.

steps.path: The same Page at phone width
steps.headline: At phone width, long sections fold, the first one open.
steps.changed: Sections marked as foldable show as plain headings on wide screens and fold on a phone.

steps.path: Phone width, the Controls section open
steps.headline: Phone: the controls section open.
steps.changed: The chip row scrolls sideways instead of wrapping.

steps.headline: Existing Pages: the kit's own pieces now follow the guide.
steps.changed: The bare-text arrows and Cancel are now outlined buttons; cards get the app's padding and shadow; dividers are the tapered line; corners follow the theme.
steps.notice: The sample Pages' own code is unchanged — only the shared kit changed.
steps.risk: Every Page made with the kit gets this slightly different look.

steps.headline: Focus timer: Reset is an outlined button now.
steps.changed: The bare-text Reset becomes outlined; buttons are slightly rounder, following the theme.
